Vendored runtime subset from the official YOLOX repository.

Upstream: https://github.com/Megvii-BaseDetection/YOLOX
Source revision: 6ddff4824372906469a7fae2dc3206c7aa4bbaee
License: Apache-2.0 (see LICENSE)

Included for this integration: yolox package, YOLOX default experiment definitions,
training/export entry points, and the upstream packaging/dependency metadata.
Large datasets, model checkpoints, demos, tests, and the upstream .git directory
are intentionally not included in this vendored runtime subset.
